# ConvexNonConvexTradeoff

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The strategic balance between convex (globally solvable) and non-convex (locally optimal) optimization steps to handle complex floorplanning constraints. Provides a practical framework for solving large-scale TCC design problems that are otherwise intractable with pure convex methods.
